title: Student Challenge Integration — Question Investigation Workbench Linkage
purpose: Defines the linkage model that enables the future Question Investigation Workbench — a May Administration feature where a student's challenge of a question answer can be traced through the full chain: Student → Attempt → Question → Certification Scan Artifact → Certification History. This specification ensures that when a student reports a potential answer-key error, the investigation agent can reconstruct the question's complete certification and defect history from a single artifact reference.

investigation_chain.description: The end-to-end trace from a student's answer challenge to the question's certification provenance. Six linked entities, each with a resolvable identifier.

stages.description: The learner who challenged a question answer. A student may challenge one or more answers during or after a practice session.
stages.data: studentId, sessionId (practice session), timestamp of challenge

stages.identifier: practice session ID + question index within session
stages.description: The specific attempt instance: which question, what answer the student selected, when, and in what practice session context.
stages.data: sessionId, qid, studentAnswer, correctAnswer (as rendered), timestamp, sessionMode (practice/review/exam)

stages.description: The exact variant of the question as rendered to the student. Resolved via compound-key identity to disambiguate template-rotation variants (S320 lesson).
stages.data: compoundKey, identityKey, pack, section, questionState at time of attempt

stages.description: The Certification Scan Artifact that contains the question's scan results from the most recent certification pipeline run.
stages.data: artifactId, timestamp, gateResults for this qid, defectFlags at scan time, readinessClass

stages.description: The complete certification provenance: when it was certified, by which session, with what quality scores, and any defect history.
stages.data: certificationDate, certificationBatch, qualityVerdict, dimensionScores, defectFlags history, version chain

investigation_workbench_queries.description: The key questions an investigation agent must be able to answer from the artifact + registry. These queries form the contract for the future Question Investigation Workbench.

queries.question: Is the student's challenged answer correct according to the stored answer key?
queries.dataSource: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json entry → components.CC vs. student's selected answer
queries.resolution: If match → student answered correctly but challenged anyway (possible explanation issue). If mismatch → investigate further.

queries.question: Has this question ever had a confirmed answer-key error (DL-030)?
queries.dataSource: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json entry → defectFlags (DL-030 with status Resolved) + DELTA_LEDGER.json entries (changeType RECERTIFY)
queries.resolution: If yes → the student's challenge may be a residual effect of a previously corrected error. Check if the correction post-dates the student's attempt.

queries.question: What defects are currently present on this question?
queries.dataSource: Most recent Certification Scan Artifact → perItemResults[this_qid].defectFlags
queries.resolution: Present defects explain degraded experience. Structural defects (DL-008, DL-026) on Certified items → legitimate student complaint.

queries.question: What was the question's state when the student took the exam?
queries.dataSource: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json entry → question_state + DELTA_LEDGER.json entries filtered by timestamp ≤ student attempt time
queries.resolution: If question_state was NOT Certified at attempt time → the question should not have been in the delivery pool (pre-delivery safety check failure). If Certified but with defects → learner-safety issue.

queries.question: Has this question been modified since the student's attempt?
queries.dataSource: DELTA_LEDGER.json entries filtered by timestamp > student attempt time. Compare content_hash at attempt time vs. current.
queries.resolution: If modified → the question the student saw may differ from the current version. Explain changes to the student.

queries.question: Are there open recommendations targeting this question?
queries.resolution: If yes → the student's challenge aligns with known defects being actively remediated. Link student's challenge to the recommendation.

queries.question: Is this question part of a template rotation group with known variant issues?
queries.dataSource: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json entry → components.Template_Family → by_template_family index → all sibling items' defectFlags
queries.resolution: If template family siblings have DL-030 or DL-016 → the student's challenge may indicate a systemic issue across the rotation group.

investigation_escalation_paths.description: When an investigation reveals a genuine defect impacting the learner, it escalates through defined paths to remediation.

paths.trigger: Student challenge → IQ-001 mismatch (student's answer is actually correct according to independent re-derivation)
paths.action: Escalate as potential DL-030 (answer-key error). Create P0 recommendation. Independent accounting re-verification required. If confirmed → correct answer key immediately.
paths.escalationLevel: P0 — potential wrong answer key in learner pool

paths.trigger: Student challenge → IQ-003 finds DL-008 or DL-026 on Certified item
paths.action: Escalate as learner-pool exposure. Create P1 recommendation. Item is already flagged in scan artifact — the challenge provides learner-facing evidence of the defect's impact.

paths.trigger: Student challenge → IQ-004 finds question was not Certified at attempt time
paths.action: Escalate as pre-delivery safety check failure. Investigate app.js delivery pool filter. The question should never have been delivered. This is a platform-level governance issue.

paths.trigger: Student challenge → IQ-005 finds question modified since attempt
paths.action: Student saw different question than current. If modification was a defect fix → acknowledge fix to student. No escalation needed. If modification introduced new defect → escalate.

paths.trigger: Student challenge → IQ-006 finds open recommendation matching challenge
paths.action: Link student's challenge to existing recommendation as additional evidence. If recommendation is P0/P1 → reaffirm priority. If recommendation is P2/P3 → consider priority escalation based on learner impact.
paths.escalationLevel: Varies — based on existing recommendation priority

student_challenge_lifecycle.description: The full lifecycle of a student challenge from submission to resolution. Future May Administration implementation.

stages.description: Student submits challenge via exam review interface. Challenge includes: qid, student answer, reason (optional comment). Stored in student_challenges.json (future).
Investigation agent performs IQ-001 through IQ-007 queries. Classifies challenge as: BUG_CONFIRMED, STUDENT_ERROR, EXPLANATION_UNCLEAR, or SYSTEM_ISSUE.
Challenge linked to existing recommendation (IQ-006) or new recommendation created. Challenge receives investigationId for tracing.
Linked recommendation resolved. Question content/answer key corrected. Change recorded in DELTA_LEDGER.json.

Student notified of resolution. If student was correct → acknowledgment + explanation of fix. If student was incorrect → explanation of why their answer was wrong, referencing the correct accounting principle.
Challenge record closed. Linked to recommendation closure evidence. Investigation metadata preserved for analytics.

future_may_administration_integration.description: The Question Investigation Workbench is a May Administration (P1) module defined in SESSION203_ADMIN_PLATFORM_SPEC.json. This specification defines the artifact-side contract that the workbench will consume.

workbench_components.artifact_dependency: IQ-001 and IQ-003 queries → most recent Certification Scan Artifact → perItemResults
workbench_components.description: Prioritized queue of open student challenges. Each entry shows: qid, studentId, challenge date, IQ-001 result, current defects, linked recommendations.

workbench_components.consumes: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json + DELTA_LEDGER.json + Certification Scan Artifact lineage
workbench_components.artifact_dependency: Full question card: identityKey, compoundKey, current question_state, last 5 delta ledger entries, current defectFlags, last certification date, template family siblings
workbench_components.description: Single-page view showing a question's complete history. Used by investigation agents to assess the context of a student challenge.

workbench_components.artifact_dependency: getByQuestion(qid) → existing recommendations. getOpenCount() → prioritization context.
workbench_components.description: Links student challenges to existing recommendations or creates new ones. Prevents duplicate investigation of the same defect.

workbench_components.consumes: Certification Scan Artifact → perItemResults (question_state + defectFlags) vs. app.js delivery filter
workbench_components.artifact_dependency: Cross-reference: items in learner delivery pool (question_state: Certified) vs. items with defects in scan artifact
workbench_components.description: Audits the delivery pool for questions that should not be delivered: uncertified items, items with CRITICAL/HIGH defects, items with DL-030 confirmed.

artifact_fields_required_by_investigatio.description: The specific fields from the Certification Scan Artifact that the Question Investigation Workbench depends on. These must never be removed or renamed.

mandatory_fields.usage: Per-gate findings (e.g., which EW slots are empty)
Which artifact versions are available for historical comparison
Verifies the pack file the student's question came from matches the scanned pack file

delivery_pool_safety_cross_reference.description: The investigation workbench must cross-reference the artifact's learner-pool exposure metrics to determine whether the student's challenge relates to a known systemic issue.

cross_reference.significance: If > 0 → P0 alert: one or more Certified items with DL-008 or DL-030. Student challenge may be one of these items.
If > 0 → P1 alert: Certified items with empty distractor slots (DL-026) or wrong-topic feedback (DL-016 SEVERE). Student may be affected.
Total items in learner pool. Provides denominator for 'challenge rate' metrics.

implementation_timeline.now: This specification (read-only) — defines the artifact-side contract
implementation_timeline.s830: NAVIGATION_REGISTRY.json built (by_question, by_session indexes) — enables IQ-001 through IQ-007 queries
implementation_timeline.s900: Question Investigation Workbench (P1) — student challenge submission, triage, linking
implementation_timeline.s910: Full investigation lifecycle — automated IQ queries, delivery pool auditor, student notification
